verdict.rationale: PayPal documents agent-driven cart and order creation through several routes. Store Sync lets AI agents "create and manage shopping carts", the cart API has a create-cart operation invoked when an AI agent starts checkout, the agent toolkit exposes a create_order tool, and the ACP path manages checkout sessions. However, the only cart endpoint evidenced besides create is get-cart, so no update operation is documented. The cart API is also a merchant-hosted reverse API that PayPal's Shopping Cart service calls, not something the agent calls directly. Access is form-gated and limited to US physical goods in USD. missing for 10: a documented cart/order update endpoint or tool, a direct agent-callable cart protocol call (instead of PayPal Shopping Cart calling merchant endpoints), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent cart creation and updates.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call

citations.quote: enabling AI agents to discover your products, create and manage shopping carts, and complete purchases on behalf of customers through conversational interfaces
